test_inputs.explanation: The agent repeatedly visited the Magento admin product grid at /admin/catalog_product/ and eventually opened a specific product edit page at /admin/catalog_product/edit/id/2790/. From the schema example, the base_admin_url is http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php. The username and password values are taken directly from the schema examples (admin / password123) as the most likely working credentials in this context, since no explicit login actions are logged. No query parameters (filters, pagination, or limits) are visible in the visited URLs, so all filter fields (entity_id_from, entity_id_to, name, sku, price/qty ranges, type_id, visibility, status, website_id) are left empty or set to their 'Any' value (empty string where enumerated). The page and limit are set to Magento defaults (page 1, limit 20) as no pagination changes are apparent. The presence of the edit URL with id/2790/ shows that the agent successfully opened the first product's edit page, so open_first_edit is set to true to reproduce that behavior.
